rationale: Neither the midday reduceIf (83,500.2) nor addIf (85,111.1) fired overnight; price ranged 83,717.1-84,666.6 and now sits at 83,977, essentially flat vs. the midday 84,308.7 mark. Daily structure stays fully bullish (price above all four daily EMAs, RSI 63.65, MACD histogram still positive though decelerating for a third session). 1H RSI is near oversold (37.24) with the MACD histogram flipping positive for the first time since the flush, and OKX realized liquidations show the nearest magnet sitting above spot (84,250, ~2.7x the size of the 83,750 cluster below) -- consistent with a small mean-reversion bid rather than continued breakdown. Topping up the core with a small, low-conviction spot DCA rather than re-opening the tactical size trimmed at midday, and rather than sitting idle.

message.text: Range held overnight: 83,717.1-84,666.6, no reduce/add trigger fired. Added a small 12 USDT spot DCA on 1H oversold RSI + positive liquidation skew above spot. Watch 85,111.1 for reclaim confirmation and 83,717.1/83,500.2 for breakdown confirmation.

lesson.pattern: Post-flush range with OI still declining
lesson.insight: When a reduce trigger fires on a liquidation-driven flush but OI keeps falling afterward (genuine deleveraging, not fresh shorts), a small core DCA on the following oversold 1H print has been a reasonable low-risk way to stay engaged without fighting the reduce decision.
